# JsBarcode

Pinned Code 128-only browser build, version 3.12.1 (MIT).

Upstream: https://github.com/lindell/JsBarcode/tree/v3.12.1

`JsBarcode.code128.min.js` is vendored unchanged. It generates the same product
barcode twice (horizontal/vertical) and one traceability barcode locally, without
sending label contents to a third party. See `LICENSE.txt` for the license.
